headline: Kyle Drops a 215 and Everyone Else Should Apologize
subhead: Put an AR to My Head pistol-whipped 226 Alpha by 71 while the rest of the league was busy leaving Taysom Hill on the bench.
matchOfTheWeek: The Olave Garden 161, Bo Nix Celli 139 — and the real story is that Patrick left 60.92 points on his bench, including a 46-point Taysom Hill nuke, and STILL won by 22. Imagine being so rich you can flush a top-3 weekly score down the toilet and still cover the spread. Meanwhile Celli got 37.8 from Brock Bowers and 28.7 from his own namesake QB and somehow lost — then traded away Bo Nix the same week, which is the most Bo Nix Celli thing that's ever happened.
powerRankingsShakeup: Put an AR to My Head just announced themselves as the team nobody wants to see in round one, while 226 Alpha is in freefall with Stafford rotting on the bench for 27.8. Stroud Boys posting the league low while Jonnu Smith drops 31 is some pure cosmic punishment.
mainRecap:
Let's start with the carnage in Newark or wherever Szara hides his roster: 215 to 143, a 71-point beatdown so violent the commissioner should've stepped in with a towel. Kyle ran 95.3% lineup efficiency — basically perfect — with Amon-Ra dropping 38.7, Goff hanging 34.5 on his own receiver, and Saquon casually adding 33.8. And the cherry on top? Szara had Matthew Stafford and his 27.8 points sitting on the pine like a healthy scratch. You started the wrong QB in a SuperFlex, my guy. That's a fireable offense.

Over in the Olave Garden, Patrick won by 22 while leaving SIXTY points on the bench. Taysom Hill went thermonuclear for 46.52 and Patrick had him riding pine behind some guy who scored a buck fifty. If you'd started him optimally you would've put up 222 and we'd be writing sonnets. Instead you're the Worst Lineup of the Week winner of a game you won. Incredible.

LargestofRocks handled The Good Ladds 144-118 thanks to Breece Hall's 31, while Mig had Noah Gray's 20.3 collecting dust. OnlyFants quietly cooked Stroud Boys, who posted the league-low 108 despite Jonnu Smith randomly turning into Gronk for a day. Bjewett, your TE outscored half your starting lineup — read that again.

Hot Cocks edged MassiveCocks in the battle of the phallic franchises 157-141, Joe Mixon going for 35.3 to settle the size debate. Tee Higgins put up 29.8 in a losing effort because that's just MassiveCocks' brand.

And Jets' Juniors smoked T swift's Baddies by 38 while Tnicolle had Jameis Winston and his 26.6 points benched — somehow not even the dumbest QB decision of the week. Wunder also added Derek Carr in a trade, which is a sentence I refuse to acknowledge further.
